fields.statement: At 91e157b I ran `go test ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/run-ship-needs-leaves -count=1 -v`: on a change set with no leaves, `rhiza run start --workflow ship-change` exited 3 with 'change set ... has no leaves: ship-change builds and reviews its leaves, so plan it first' and 'next: rhiza run start plan' (the --json form carried "next": "rhiza run start plan"), .git/rhiza/runs did not exist and `git worktree list` showed only the main checkout; after adding capability `thing` the same command printed 'Run <id> succeeded' and journaled the run. The diff puts checkShipLeaves in runRunStart after the change set resolves and before newRunID, the journal or the worktree are made. `go test ./...`, go vet and gofmt passed; make self-check failed only on rendered files for this verifier session's own actor, which is not in the leaf commit.
